details: This package is an unofficial republish of the @whiskeysockets/baileys WhatsApp Web automation library under the @ubedsockets scope, carrying added code that disables itself for every host except one hard-coded address. In lib/Socket/socket.js, the makeSocket() constructor runs an "IP PROTECTION SYSTEM" block: it fetches the installing host's public IPv4 address from hxxps://api[.]ipify[.]org?format=json and calls process.exit(1) with the message "This version of Baileys is locked to <ip>" unless the returned address equals 20[.]207[.]192[.]84. The library therefore terminates immediately on almost every machine, including CI runners, unless the author's gate is satisfied. The publish also ships scraper helpers that forward caller-supplied URLs to third-party services — lib/Utils/youtube.js to hxxps://api[.]fruatre[.]my[.]id/api/ytplay and lib/Utils/Tiktok.js to hxxps://api[.]vreden[.]my[.]id and hxxps://api[.]siputzx[.]my[.]id — and embeds a fixed WhatsApp newsletter reference, JID 120363423295236859@newsletter ("veyzen"), into forwarded-message metadata generated in lib/Socket/setup.js. No credential, token, environment-variable or file exfiltration was found, and the WhatsApp WebSocket endpoint remains the stock wss://web[.]whatsapp[.]com/ws/chat.
